Hospitality Agent Front Office

Stellenbeschreibung

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. At The Cloud One Hotels, our goal is to foster an environment where both guests and team members feel comfortable and genuinely welcomed! Your responsibilities include:

- Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Whether you're a professional in the hospitality industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central's most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central's ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you'll be doing

 * Own Central's intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

 * Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

 * Own Central's courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

 * Own and report on Central's UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

 * Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

 * Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

 * Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central's supply health.

Our humble expectations

 * Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

 * Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

 * Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

 * Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

 * Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 * Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.

 * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 *  Experience in power electronic systems
 * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have.

1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.

You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. This thesis focuses on advanced optical modulation techniques and experimental characterization of photonic systems. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation.  * Experimental characterization of photonic and acousto-optic components:
 ** Characterizing the performance of an acousto-optic modulator (AOM).
 ** Setting up and performing heterodyne measurement experiments.
 ** Analyzing measured data and extracting key performance metrics.
